cases.setup: Install only the built runtime wheel and its declared dependencies in a new environment
cases.expected: Import, verified bundle load, and scoring succeed without the simulator, scikit-learn, or xgboost

cases.setup: Block prohibited module prefixes while importing runtime and starting ASGI
cases.expected: Import and startup succeed and no prohibited prefix appears in sys.modules

cases.setup: Score predeclared raw-v6 records including unknown category and tier thresholds
cases.expected: Probability, tier, queue, and additive explanation results match the frozen compatibility path within accepted tolerance

cases.setup: Score identical records through direct single, direct batch, HTTP single, and HTTP batch APIs
cases.expected: All result fields are consistent for every occurrence

cases.setup: Set INFORSIGHT_MODEL_BUNDLE_PATH to a nonexistent file
cases.expected: Startup fails and does not try the repository or image default

cases.setup: Supply readable bundle bytes with a nonmatching trusted digest
cases.expected: Startup fails before parsing or readiness

cases.setup: Supply correctly hashed fixture bytes with an unexpected bundle ID
cases.expected: Startup fails after structural validation and before engine readiness

cases.setup: Supply correctly hashed fixture bytes with an unsupported bundle version
Exercise invalid UTF-8, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, missing fields, and coefficient/column mismatch
cases.expected: Each mutation fails deterministically without changing the release bundle

cases.setup: Start with explicit trusted digest, ID, and version
cases.expected: GET /health reports verified runtime and bundle identity only after engine readiness

cases.setup: Build the canonical Dockerfile from a clean context without relying on cached project installs
cases.expected: Image runs as non-root, exposes only HTTP 8000, passes /health, and scores single and batch requests

cases.setup: Compare source, Dockerfile, serving documentation, and test configuration
cases.expected: ASGI target, environment names, assets, port, health route, and scoring routes match contract 1.0.0

cases.setup: Inspect active Docker and Compose documentation
cases.expected: Java, gRPC, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and full-stack Compose are labeled non-runnable scaffolds and are not RH-06 evidence

cases.setup: Run existing intentional training/export/evaluation consumers through the compatibility facade
cases.expected: Tests pass and protected bundle and historical evidence remain byte-identical
